[[Category:BITwiki Ontology]]
<includeonly>

= BITwiki Validation Rules =

== Purpose ==

Validation rules ensure BITwiki content meets structural, semantic, and epistemic standards. They are not barriers to contribution but quality checks that maintain knowledge integrity.

Rules operate at three levels:
* '''Structural''': Required fields, valid formats
* '''Semantic''': Meaningful relationships, consistent typing
* '''Epistemic''': Appropriate confidence, traceable sources

== Structural Validation ==

=== Required Properties ===

| Rule | Check | Severity | Rationale |
|------|-------|----------|-----------|
| Entity type | `Has entity type` present | Error | Cannot query without type |
| Title | `Has title` or page title present | Error | Cannot identify without title |
| Epistemic status | `Has epistemic status` present | Warning | Users need confidence guidance |

'''Example Violation:'''
```wiki
[[Has name::Feedback Loop]]  # Missing entity type
```

'''Correction:'''
```wiki
[[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has name::Feedback Loop]]
[[Has epistemic status::Verified]]
```

=== Valid Values ===

| Property | Valid Values | Severity |
|----------|--------------|----------|
| Entity type | Topic, Idea, Implementation, Project, Protocol, Dataset, Person, Organization, Event, Publication, Location | Error |
| Epistemic status | Hypothetical, Emerging, Established, Verified, Deprecated, Disputed | Error |
| Confidence score | 0.0-1.0 | Warning |

'''Example Violation:'''
```wiki
[[Has epistemic status::Proven]]  # Invalid value
```

'''Correction:'''
```wiki
[[Has epistemic status::Verified]]  # Valid value
```

== Semantic Validation ==

=== Relationship Targets ===

| Rule | Check | Severity |
|------|-------|----------|
| Target exists | Linked page exists | Warning |
| Type compatibility | Source and target types compatible | Warning |
| No circularity | Part-of relationships don't create cycles | Error |

'''Example Violation (Circularity):'''
```wiki
Page A: [[Part of::Page B]]
Page B: [[Part of::Page A]]
```

'''Resolution:''' Remove one relationship or clarify part-whole semantics.

=== Property Types ===

| Property | Expected Type | Example |
|----------|---------------|---------|
| Has date | Date (ISO 8601) | 2026-02-12 |
| Has confidence score | Float (0.0-1.0) | 0.85 |
| Has citation count | Integer | 15000 |
| Has coordinates | Geo coordinates | 42.3601,-71.0942 |

'''Example Violation:'''
```wiki
[[Has confidence score::High]]  # Wrong type
```

'''Correction:'''
```wiki
[[Has confidence score::0.85]]  # Correct type
```

== Epistemic Validation ==

=== Confidence Calibration ===

| Status | Confidence Range | Evidence Required |
|----------|------------------|-------------------|
| Hypothetical | 0.0-0.3 | Logical coherence |
| Emerging | 0.3-0.5 | Single credible source |
| Established | 0.5-0.75 | Multiple sources |
| Verified | 0.75-1.0 | Extensive replication |
| Deprecated | Any | Explanation of replacement |
| Disputed | Any | Multiple conflicting sources |

'''Example Violation:'''
```wiki
[[Has epistemic status::Hypothetical]]
[[Has confidence score::0.9]]  # Mismatch: hypothetical with high confidence
```

'''Correction:'''
```wiki
[[Has epistemic status::Verified]]
[[Has confidence score::0.9]]
```

=== Source Requirements ===

| Claim Type | Source Requirement | Severity |
|------------|-------------------|----------|
| Established | At least 2 independent sources | Warning |
| Verified | At least 5 sources or meta-analysis | Warning |
| Quantitative | Primary source with methodology | Error |
| Attribution | Source linking claim to originator | Warning |

'''Example Violation:'''
```wiki
[[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has name::New Theory]]
[[Has epistemic status::Verified]]  # No sources provided
```

'''Correction:'''
```wiki
[[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has name::New Theory]]
[[Has epistemic status::Emerging]]
[[Has source::Single study 2025]]
```

== Content Validation ==

=== Definition Requirements ===

| Entity Type | Definition Required | Severity |
|-------------|---------------------|----------|
| Idea | Yes | Warning |
| Topic | Yes | Warning |
| Protocol | Yes | Warning |
| Implementation | Recommended | Info |

'''Example Violation:'''
```wiki
[[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has name::Emergence]]
# No definition provided
```

'''Correction:'''
```wiki
[[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has name::Emergence]]
[[Has definition::System properties not predictable from component properties]]
```

=== Citation Requirements ===

| Claim Type | Citation Required | Severity |
|------------|-------------------|----------|
| Direct quote | Yes | Error |
| Statistical claim | Yes | Warning |
| Historical fact | Recommended | Info |
| Common knowledge | No | None |

'''Example:'''
```wiki
"Cybernetics was founded in 1948"  # Common knowledge, no citation needed

"Wiener's book sold 10,000 copies in first year"  # Statistical, citation needed
[[Has source::Publisher records 1948-1949]]
```

== Validation Process ==

# '''Automated checks''': Run on save, flag violations
# '''Editor review''': Human judgment on warnings
# '''Community audit''': Periodic review of disputed content
# '''Epistemic committee''': Final arbitration on status changes

Violations are not failures—they are opportunities for improvement. A page with warnings is still valuable; a page with errors may need correction before it can be fully trusted.

</includeonly>
